title: RESILAGENT: A Three-Pillar Architecture for Cyber-Physical Resilience in Electrical Power and Energy Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.21480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electrical Power and Energy Systems face hybrid threats that combine cyber intrusions, physical sabotage and climate-driven stress, and routinely outpace today's siloed monitoring stacks. We present RESILAGENT, a concept architecture organised around three operational pillars, Sensing & Data Intelligence, Resilience Analytics & Reporting, and Incident Response & Recovery, mediated by a Cloud-based Orchestrator and exercised through a closed Detect-Simulate-Decide-Sign loop. The framework fuses agentic artificial intelligence and multimodal large language models for cross-modal detection, real-time digital twins for what-if simulation, and a permissioned blockchain anchor for tamper-evident threat intelligence and CER/NIS2-aligned evidence. translated_title: RESILAGENT：面向电力与能源系统网络物理韧性的三支柱架构
translated_abstract: 电力与能源系统面临着网络入侵、物理破坏和气候压力相互交织的混合威胁，其演变速度往往超越当今各自孤立的监测体系。我们提出了RESILAGENT，一种围绕三个运营支柱构建的概念架构——感知与数据智能、韧性分析与报告、事件响应与恢复——由基于云的编排器进行协调，并通过“检测-仿真-决策-签名”的闭环机制加以运作。该框架融合了智能体人工智能与多模态大语言模型以实现跨模态检测，利用实时数字孪生进行假设情景仿真，并采用许可区块链锚定机制提供防篡改的威胁情报以及符合CER/NIS2法规要求的证据。我们在两个场景中对该架构进行了实例化验证：一是输电运营商同时遭受协同网络攻击、物理破坏与热浪冲击的场景，二是配电运营商在风暴期间遭遇供应链攻击的场景。
tldr: 该论文提出RESILAGENT三支柱概念架构，融合智能体AI与多模态大语言模型、实时数字孪生和许可区块链，通过“检测-仿真-决策-签名”闭环提升电力与能源系统应对网络攻击、物理破坏和气候灾害等混合威胁的网络物理韧性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RESILAGENT, a three-pillar concept architecture that fuses agentic AI with multimodal LLMs, real-time digital twins, and permissioned blockchain within a closed Detect-Simulate-Decide-Sign loop to enhance cyber-physical resilience of power and energy systems against hybrid cyber, physical, and climate-driven threats.
